build_system: Vite 6 with React plugin, npm workspaces
test_framework: No test framework configured in client package.json
verification_instructions: 1. Run tsc --noEmit to verify type-checking passes. 2. Run vite build to verify production build succeeds.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - can install any npm packages. Node.js v22. Server must remain unchanged.
contribution_requirements: Only modify frontend code (client/ directory). Server stays the same. API types and endpoints are fixed.
key_patterns: - Uses react-router-dom v7 for routing. - Uses react-i18next for i18n (en.json, zh.json). - Uses axios API client in src/api.ts. - Utility functions in src/utils.ts: getDisplayName(person, locale), getBirthYear(person). - All styles in src/index.css. - Layout component provides sidebar navigation. - AuthContext for auth state. - Current graph uses @xyflow/react with custom layout (to be replaced). - GraphView route: /graph, AncestryView route: /graph/:id. - GraphNode type has: id, names, bioGender, lifeFrom, lifeEnd. - GraphEdge type has: id, fromPersonId, toPersonId, relationType (spouse/child/parent), subType, spouseFrom, spouseEnd.
directory_structure: client/src/ - main source. client/src/components/ - all React components. client/src/contexts/ - AuthContext. client/src/i18n/ - translation files. client/src/api.ts - API client. client/src/types.ts - shared TS types. client/src/utils.ts - display helpers.
